security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, SSEED (bit 9) and USEED (bit 8) of mseccfg are declared as RO (Read-Only) fields with implicit reset value 0 and no writable path. This hardwires both fields to zero permanently. The seed CSR (address 0x015) is listed in the CSR address table but has no CSRModule implementation registered in csrRwMap, so any access to seed triggers the noCSRIllegal path regardless of privilege mode. Together, these mean (a) the access control mechanism mandated by the spec (USEED/SSEED gating U/S-mode seed access) can never be enabled, and (b) the seed CSR itself is entirely absent, making the Zkr entropy source extension non-functional at the hardware level. If seed CSR were later added without changing SSEED/USEED from RO to RW/WARL, S/HS-mode and U-mode seed accesses would always raise illegal-instruction regardless of the spec-intended access control bit values.
security_spec.summary: mseccfg.SSEED and USEED are hardwired Read-Only zero with seed CSR unimplemented, violating the spec's access-control model that requires writable fields to gate S/U-mode entropy source access via Zkr extension
